new_today_news.headline: New Pizza Shop Opens on North Queen Street
new_today_news.summary: A 20-seat pizza restaurant opened in Lancaster, Pennsylvania in the former Slugger's Pizzeria space on November 25, 2026. The restaurant serves pizza, stromboli, subs, and other items, occupying a space that had been vacant since spring.

new_today_news.headline: Pittsburgh Restaurant Openings and Closings in 2026
new_today_news.summary: Axios tracked Pittsburgh-area restaurant openings and closings for November 2026, including Driftwood Oven expanding to a second location, Opal Grand Buffet opening at Homestead, Sokoya opening as a Japanese izakaya, and several closures including Fish Nor Fowl and ShadoBeni.

recent_news.headline: The Electric Waste Collection Trucks Market is Projected to Expand at a 20.3% CAGR Until 2030
recent_news.summary: Market report on electric waste collection trucks growing from $0.25 billion in 2025 to $0.3 billion in 2026 at 20.6% CAGR. Grundon deploys electric trucks powered by facility waste energy.

recent_news.headline: Used Cooking Oil (UCO) Biofuel Market: Recent Developments in Feedstock Quality and Output
recent_news.summary: Market reporting indicates usable output from UCO collection operations increased approximately 11%, with impurity-related rejection falling nearly 9%, supporting cleaner feedstock delivery to renewable diesel producers. Roughly 62% of regional feedstock originates from foodservice sources, with renewable diesel producers absorbing 55% of collected oil.
